details: US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have experienced their most significant inflow week since April, attracting over $1 billion. BlackRock's IBIT and ETHA products were major contributors, collectively drawing approximately $896 million.
title: Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs See Strongest Inflows Since April

details: A bipartisan ethics provision within the proposed Clarity Act, a landmark crypto regulation bill, could enable former President Trump to defer millions in federal taxes on his crypto gains. This would occur if he divests from his crypto-related businesses, a condition now seen as crucial for the bill's passage.
title: Clarity Act Provision Could Offer Trump Millions in Crypto Tax Deferrals

details: Supporters of Bitcoin Improvement Proposal (BIP-110) are pursuing a split onto a minority chain. A Bitcoin developer has cautioned that a potential BIP-110 fork could expose holders to replay attacks if they attempt to move or sell coins before properly separating their balances on the respective chains.
title: Bitcoin's BIP-110 Fork Raises Replay Attack Concerns

details: Russian authorities have escalated their efforts against unregistered cryptocurrency exchanges in Moscow, conducting raids and arresting over 20 individuals. Reports indicate some of the targeted exchanges are suspected of having connections to Ukraine.
sourceName: Whale Alert (citing multiple sources including Cointelegraph, CoinDesk)
title: Russia Cracks Down on Unlicensed Crypto Exchanges

details: Bitcoin's price has stabilized around $64,700 with relatively low volatility. However, market risk persists as investors await crucial U.S. jobs data, which could influence the Federal Reserve's stance on interest rates. Analysts emphasize that current low volatility does not necessarily equate to low risk.
title: Bitcoin Volatility Low Ahead of Key US Jobs Data
